narrative.northStar: Dual-Bus Studio Patch Bay & Operator Deck
narrative.overview: NovaShare approaches cross-platform backup not as a passive consumer cloud uploader, but as a precision benchtop routing deck connecting a Windows Laptop Source Bus, a central Dual-Lane Transfer Pipeline Bus, and a Linux Omarchy Destination Bus. Every pixel in the interface reports concrete filesystem paths, statfs partition capacity, or SHA-256 verification physics.
keyCharacteristics: Three-Bus Architectural Patch Bay: A unified 1px hairline grid (1fr 1.35fr 1fr) where Source, Pipeline, and Destination sit side by side without nested card containers.
Single Reversed Status Plate: One high-contrast reversed plate (#09090b in light mode) anchors the primary transfer percentage, byte counter, and real-time throughput (MB/s and ETA).
Whole-Cell Signal Matrix: A 48-cell (16x3 desktop, 8x6 mobile) verification grid displaying verified (#047857), delta-skipped (#1d4ed8), active (#b45309), and pending chunks.
Inline Modal-Free Directory Exploration: Windows and remote Linux Omarchy directory trees live directly inside their respective bus columns alongside inline folder creation.

rules.name: The Single Reversed Plate Rule
rules.body: Exactly one element per screen—the primary telemetry readout plate (.ns-telemetry-plate)—may invert the ground to solid Carbon Black (#09090b) with alabaster type (#fafafa). No secondary panel or badge may compete with it.

rules.name: The State-Only Hue Rule
rules.body: Saturated colors (Signal Blue, Verified Emerald, In-Flight Amber, Fault Crimson) never appear as decorative backgrounds or borders; they encode live transfer or connection state only.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every element displaying bytes, percentages, file counts, throughput (MB/s), or ETA must enforce font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so digits never jitter during high-frequency SSE updates.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved exclusively for filesystem paths, URLs, secret tokens, and terminal logs—never as a decorative label style.

rules.name: The Zero Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Elevation is declared once via a 1px structural hairline (#e4e4e7 light / #27272a dark). Pairing a 1px border with a soft drop shadow is prohibited.

dos: Do use lucide-react icons at 1.75px stroke width (14px–20px) for all actions and status indicators.
Do keep Windows and Linux folder selection inline inside their respective Patch Bay columns.
Do apply .ns-tabular (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) to every byte count, speed, percentage, and file counter.
Do maintain a single outer border around the three-column Patch Bay with 1px internal dividers rather than wrapping each section in nested cards.
donts: Don't place kickers or uppercase eyebrow labels above headings; let headings carry their own hierarchy.
Don't use emoji or Unicode symbols in place of Lucide vector icons.
Don't introduce modal dialogs for directory browsing or routine job configuration.
Don't combine 1px borders with drop shadows or glassmorphic backdrop-filter blurs.
